narrative.overview:
The session is a strip of gym route tape and every logged set is a tick on the send list. The screen is a warm brown-black wall with ivory text and one workhorse condensed grotesk. Colour is not decoration: each tracking type owns one tape colour, and that colour is the only saturated thing on screen. Logging is the one job, so everything else is quiet, large and close to the thumb.

Density is low and targets are big (48 to 64px). Depth is tonal, not lifted. The single signature gesture is the tape roll: when a set is logged, a strip of grain-textured tape sweeps across its slot on a slanted leading edge in about 220ms and the session strip fills.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, warm near-black, ivory ink, no pure black or white.
One saturated hue at a time, set per screen through the --tape variable.
Tape is a material: fine horizontal fibre grain over the colour, never a flat fill.
Condensed display face with tabular numerals for everything the user reads mid-set.
56px minimum control height, 64px pinned primary button.

rules.name: The One Tape Rule
rules.body: A screen shows one exercise's tape colour at a time through --tape. Other tape colours appear only as completed or pending segments in the session strip. Components read var(--tape); they never hard-code a tape hex.

rules.name: The Tape Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on tape is always Tape Ink (#14150f), never ivory or black.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans brown (red channel above blue). No cool grey, no pure #000 or #fff.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Any value that changes or is compared uses the .num class.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All labels and button text are sentence case and name the result. There is no uppercase styling anywhere in the build.

dos: Do drive every accent from --tape set on the screen root from the exercise's tracking type.
Do lay text on tape in Tape Ink (#14150f) and give tape surfaces the grain fill, not a flat colour.
Do keep controls at 48px or taller, the primary at 64px, and pin it to the bottom.
Do use .num for every number and sentence-case labels that name the result.
Do keep depth tonal (ground, surface, surface-2) and use the inset tape ring for the current item.
Do honour reduced motion: no scale, no wipe, still start and end demo frames.
donts: Don't introduce a fifth saturated hue or put two tape colours in the working area at once.
Don't use cool greys, pure black or pure white.
Don't use drop shadows or glows to lift surfaces.
Don't show a work timer for reps or reps per side; countdowns belong only to rest and timed holds.
Don't add promotion, decoration or interruptions during an exercise.
